text: The parent actor changes its named FaviconUtils import to moz-src:///toolkit/modules/FaviconUtils.sys.mjs. The same patch removes the explicit browser/modules/FaviconUtils MOZ_SRC_FILES entry from the actor build file. It keeps the separate FaviconLoader module and browser LinkHandlerChild actor packaging. The actor's icon-conversion and guard logic is unchanged by this relocation. These comm facts do not verify toolkit module contents, paired engine provenance or runtime packaging success.
title: Favicon utility relocation changes both the import and explicit source packaging
